correctness.rationale: The unit-cube polynomial \(t+3t^2+3t^3\) is bijective over the 3-adic integers by Hensel lifting, giving two uniform unit-cube cosets. The four unit-input sign classes and the both-nonunit branch are exhaustive and disjoint. This yields the exact finite-depth normalization; squaring gives \(M_n=2+M_{n-3}/3\) with verified bases. Valuation annuli prove \(F\in L^s\) exactly for \(0<s<3\); martingale conditional expectations yield convergence. The standalone verifier checks 9841 exact targets and 12 rational moments but is not an infinite proof.
